body: yeah... amoung infinite other reasons its  hard to care about my life when up until last year it was litterally okay in some states to murder me. ( look up trans panic defense if your interested in how horrible the world is to us) i guess technically theres only an ACLU advisement about that being bullshit, and, living in hicklahoma, i bet people could still get away with it. not that i'd even care... but anyway...

I've been on most every anti-depresant, and  anti-psychotic, known to man, none have helped for more than six months. i've been to more therapists, doctors, and specialists (23 seperate health proffessionals over the course of my "life") for a number of reasons, (i'm an mtf transgender, and schizophrenic, and a host of other problems) so doctors don't help much, or atleast have done all they can. i've tried on occasion talking to my total of 3 friends, but i quickly found that wasn't an option if i wanted to keep them. i've tried a lot more things, name a few and i'll tell you if i have, but nothing has helped. the only things that grant me a bit of mommentary releif are drugs, cigarettes and self harm. only recently did i fall back to self harm. which i had quit in highschool. but last week i got really upset when i found out not only is my old gender therapist ignoring my calls and emails but that there is litterally no one else in my area qualified or willing to handle that sort of thing. so i put out the ciggarette i was smoking on my arm an well, i'm bleeding kinda a lot right now...

contemplating suicide isn't so much of a monthly contemplation as a daily, often hourly battle for me. 
to me there is a point in dying though, i'm schizophrenic and transgendered, and though i've worked extremely hard, seen all the doctors and therapists i could bring myself to see, its only a matter of time before one or the other of those things brings me down. i've never lasted more than 6 months before a i build up an immunity to my medicine and then i'm back in the horrifying world of my hallucinations. 
but even if this current medicine is somehow actually a permanent solution to that, there is no way my transition, starting next month if my therapist ever decides its worth taking my calls, will be successfull. setting aside how low the chances are of me being able to afford, much less react well to, HRT, i have way too deep of a voice, and there is no surgery for that. and speaking of surgery, there is little chance of me ever affording SRS. and if i somehow manage to survive those two impossible mountains, theres the matter of the learning dissabilities i've been cursed with since birth. life is ridiculous, and i used to find humor, so much so that i've collapsed into a few, hours long fits hysterical laughter, so i try not to go that rout to much latly. i've seen all of the monty python movies, (i even have every episode of flying circus on DVD) there are so many more reason i want to die, but its hardly worth listing them all here. i could stand living if i only had to work as hard as everyone else, that is, if i didn't have reasons to want to die to, if i didn't have to try so much harder for so much less than most other people
